messages:
Priya S: Quick heads-up 1: week2 smoke for Nimbus private/VPC deploy. Customer reports audit logs are sporadic in S3 and KMS alias 'nimbus-prod' is not visible from our side. Theyre worried about meeting the BETA milestone and mentioned renewal hesitation if we cant stabilize event delivery. Can infra/customer success triage?

Ethan L: I can take the KMS/S3 side. First ask: did they create the cross-account delivery role? Also which region are they using for KMS?

Priya S: Theyre in us-west-2 (confirmed). I asked them for outputs, they posted this (sanitized):
```
aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2 --profile customer
# returns: alias/redwood-internal, alias/nimbus-staging
# NO alias/nimbus-prod
```
and
```
aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket nimbus-audit-logs --profile customer
# bucket policy allows PutObject from aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-xxxxxxxx but no explicit account arn
```
Also they said they didnt create the RedwooodLogDelivery role; only our account has it.

Miguel R: Classic cross-account role miss. If bucket policy uses org-based condition, CloudTrail delivery might fail if the role/principal differs. Ask them to run `aws iam list-roles | grep Redwood` and paste.

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-8791, priority P1 if audit gaps persist. Reminder set for 20m.

Devon C: Ill draft a minimal role/trust snippet and a one-page checklist for them to run. We should give them two remediation paths: 1) quick staging fallback (enable staging prefix + use alias/nimbus-staging) to prove delivery, 2) full prod path (create alias/nimbus-prod or point KMS grant to our service principal).

Ethan L: From my side, other thing: KMS aliases are per-account/per-region. Its possible they created the alias under a different key or in another account. Ask them to run: 
```
aws kms list-keys --region us-west-2 --profile customer
aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2 --profile customer
```
If the key exists but alias is missing, they can run `create-alias` or we can suggest using a customer-managed key with proper key policy that allows our service principal: `arn:aws:iam::REDSRV:role/RedwoodLogService` (well provide exact ARN).

Priya S: I've messaged them with the commands and linked the quick role snippet. I also flagged renewal owner (Sales: Karen M) and asked legal about a temporary SLA credit for missed BETA if we cant meet timeline. Please avoid promising anything.

Miguel R: Scheduling a 15m join with Sales + CS now at 11:30 PT to align on potential credit language and next steps. @Devon C please drop the IAM snippet in the ticket and pin it here.

Devon C: Snippet posted to ticket CS-8791 and paste here for visibility:
```
# Create trust policy (replace ACCOUNT_ID)
aws iam create-role --role-name RedwoodLogDelivery --assume-role-policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"ACCOUNT_ID"}}}]}'
# attach minimal policy for PutObject to audit bucket
```
Also included one-paragraph runbook: "If audit objects are not appearing, verify cross-account role exists, bucket policy allows s3:PutObject for CloudTrail principal, and KMS key policy permits encrypt/decrypt for the CloudTrail service principal. Use staging prefix to validate end-to-end before enabling prod alias."

Ethan L: Good. If theyre comfortable, ask them to enable staging prefix and run `aws s3 ls s3://nimbus-audit-logs/staging/ --recursive | tail -n 20` and share results. That will at least give us events to audit.

Priya S: Customer replied: they ran the checks and returned outputs showing no RedwoodLogDelivery role and bucket policy with org condition only. They enabled staging prefix and saw a handful of objects there, but KMS decrypt fails when we try to access them from our side.

Miguel R: KMS decrypt fails means key policy likely restricts usage to account principals. We'll need them to add a grant to allow our service principal, or add our account to the key policy. I'll draft the conservative grant flow (grant to specific principal) and share.

Devon C: Draft grant flow posted in ticket. Also recommend temporary mitigation: we can ask the customer to export the audit objects to a shared S3 prefix and we can ingest for the smoke run while they adjust key policy. That avoids downtime and buys time for prod KMS changes.

Priya S: This is helpful. I told them the plan: enable staging prefix (done), apply grant (they will try), or export objects to shared prefix. Sales is standing by for renewal convo; I'm coordinating legal for credit language but nothing promised.

ops-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 1799955000. Ticket CS-8791 updated: status=investigating, assigned=Ethan L, Devon C.

Ethan L: I'll verify decrypt once they apply grant. If successful, we mark Week2 smoke as green and escalate to full cutover checklist. If not, we plan a short working session with customer tomorrow morning.

Priya S: Perfect. Thanks all. Ill update the CS runbook and post a short summary for Sales before the 11:30 sync.

Miguel R: +1. Keep me posted if they hit any permission errors.

Devon C: Will follow up in-ticket with exact policy snippets.

Priya S: Closing loop here until we get their grant/decrypt result. :pray:

ops-bot: Note: if audit continuity is not confirmed by 1799956600, CS owner will escalate to Director of Customer Success.
